verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs list faceted navigation as a product capability ('Browse & Navigation - Category pages, filtering, and faceted navigation'). InstantSearch's refinementList widget lets users refine results by attribute values such as brand, and the quickstart filters by product type. Community comments note category refinement and filtering by type in practice. missing for 10: evidence of live per-facet counts, numeric/range facets, confirmation that multiple facets resolve from a single query, and in-depth faceting API documentation.
